lamplighters_knot.name: A Lamplighter's Knot
lamplighters_knot.flavor: Tied by the shift-boss, where anyone who reads the Weft can see it.
redeem_lines: Ash lifts his chin. The knot in his thread catches the lamplight and everyone pretends not to look.
'That one,' the shift-boss says. 'Fine. That one buys you the door and nothing said after.'
The knot slips loose. Debts settled are the only kind that stop being useful.

wick_knot.name: A Guildmaster's Knot
wick_knot.flavor: A knot on a man who has never owed anyone visibly. He hates it. That is the interest.
redeem_lines: Wick sees the knot before he sees the cat. He was always going to.
'Once,' he says. 'You get this once, and then we are strangers again.'
Once is what a knot is for.
